changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK','RETRACT_FEEDBACK')); -- A send that had not settled when the instance stopped runs again as the first action of its feedback's lane. -- A copy whose write may have reached the provider keeps its fence, so that action reads it back before it writes. INSERT INTO agent_action (id, workspace_id, kind, lane_key, idempotency_key, state, payload, subject_account_id, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT uuidv7(), s.workspace_id, CASE s.action WHEN 'EDIT' THEN 'EDIT_FEEDBACK' WHEN 'RETRACT' THEN 'RETRACT_FEEDBACK' ELSE 'DELIVER_FEEDBACK' END, 'feedback:' || s.feedback_id, 'feedback:' || s.feedback_id || ':1:' || s.action, 'ADMITTED', jsonb_build_object('feedbackId', s.feedback_id), f.developer_id, 8, clock_timestamp(), s.created_at, clock_timestamp() FROM feedback_send s JOIN feedback f ON f.id = s.feedback_id AND f.workspace_id = s.workspace_id WHERE s.state IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING', 'UNCERTAIN') ORDER BY s.next_attempt_at, s.feedback_id; DROP TABLE feedback_send; DROP FUNCTION guard_feedback_send_destination();
